description: A white round tabletop base with a central threaded socket sits on the wooden surface, and a white cross-shaped support piece lies nearby on the right. The left hand stays planted on the table while the right hand reaches to the cross-shaped piece, lifts it, moves it left over the base, and lowers it onto the central post to align and seat it, making the base the right-hand object while the left hand remains not touching any object.
